title: Wikipedia geometry item 14: Nagata–Biran conjecture that if $X$ is a smooth algebraic surface and $L$ is an ample line bund…
exact_target: Nagata–Biran conjecture that if $X$ is a smooth algebraic surface and $L$ is an ample line bundle on $X$ of degree $d$, then for sufficiently large $r$, the Seshadri constant satisfies $\varepsilon(p_1,\ldots,p_r;X,L) = d/\sqrt{r}$.
